description: derm policy gate for Codex. Codex runs each line with its shell and lets a call through when a hook fails or times out, so derm's hook never crashes on purpose and caps its own waits below this timeout. /bin/sh by its absolute path runs hooks/derm-gate.sh, which runs `derm hook codex <event>` from derm's install folders, never from PATH (contracts/hook-dialects.md 9.1; rules case 227).
